rent-use.description: Rental and booking platform for finding, renting, and managing listings.
rent-use.content: Rent Use is a full-stack rental and booking platform built with Laravel. Users can browse and search listings by category and location, view detailed property information, add listings to favorites, and make bookings. The platform also includes a subscription system, real-time chat, an admin dashboard, and tools for managing listings, bookings, and users

surv-gear.content: An e-commerce platform for outdoor, survival, and camping gear. The project includes user authentication, product categories, a fully developed shopping cart, product browsing, and a simulated checkout process

early-projects.content: A collection of my early projects built while learning web development. These are small apps and exercises covering different concepts and technologies, made as part of the learning process before moving on to larger full-stack builds.
